aid.value: International applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships and need-based assistance after completing their application. Full scholarships are unavailable; a personal contribution is required. Submit Lawrence's own Certification of Finance and supporting documents within five days of the admission deadline; CSS Profile cannot replace it. Awards renew at the same level subject to the published terms.

evidence.quote: full scholarships are not available

english.value: Proficiency evidence is required. Accepted thresholds include IELTS 6.5, DET 115, TOEFL iBT 80 before January 21, 2026 or 4.0 thereafter, SAT EBRW 580, or ACT English/Writing 24. English as the primary language or school-official confirmation of English-medium high school can establish proficiency. Test agencies must send scores directly; student/counselor copies are not accepted.

evidence.quote: IELTS 6.5 out of 9 overall band score

fee.value: No application fee for international applicants.

evidence.quote: does not charge an application fee

deadline.value: First-year fall applications: ED November 1, EA December 1, ED II and RD January 15; later applications are also accepted. Certification of Finance is due within five days of the application deadline. The page is not entry-year labelled. Conservatory applicants need an audition and separate round guidance; do not infer their eligibility from this general schedule.

evidence.quote: Regular Decision Jan. 15 April 1 May 1

aid.value: International undergraduates can apply for institutional need-based aid using Soka's International Student Financial Aid Application. Grants, scholarships and institutional loans are distinct aid types; loans are optional and not free funding. Apply by February 15 for priority review, no later than March 2; verify requested financial documents in the Learn portal. This page does not establish a universal full-cost award or need-blind admission policy.

attributes.aidShort: Institutional need-based aid; separate international form

evidence.quote: International students are eligible for need-based financial aid

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for undergraduate admission. Submitted scores must be official and no older than five years; SAT Subject Tests are not required.

evidence.quote: Official ACT or SAT scores (optional)

english.value: Non-native speakers demonstrate proficiency with TOEFL or DET. Preferred thresholds are TOEFL iBT 4 (80 before January 2026) or DET 115. IELTS and Cambridge English are not accepted. Official agency scores are required, within two years; self-reports are not accepted. These are undergraduate rules, not the graduate program's separate requirements.

evidence.quote: We do not accept the IELTS or Cambridge English.

fee.value: $30 undergraduate application fee. Soka accepts Common Application, College Board and NACAC fee waivers; submit an eligible waiver or payment to complete the application.

evidence.quote: $30 application fee

deadline.value: Undergraduate application and documents: nonbinding EA November 1; Regular Admission January 15.
